label: RU

notes.grounding: Most claims match the script: unconditional exit 0 at line 587, options --verbose/--json/--file/--quality/--help, printf %.0f rounding and clamp to 0 (lines 290-302), bc dependency, Bash 3.2 note, section numbers 3/4/7/8 used in plan.md. Two claims are wrong: the 79.6% rounding example cannot occur because bc scale=2 truncates the division so the value is already an integer, and stderr is not always empty (quality warnings and NOT FOUND go to stderr). No line numbers cited for the change point.
notes.requirements: Testable REQ table covering exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N, byte-identical stdout, missing/non-numeric/out-of-range values exit 1 with ERROR on stderr, --file mode and composition with other flags. REQ-003 acceptance relies on an unreachable 79.6% value.
notes.verification: No task in tasks.md has a Verify: clause naming a command and expected output. Spec acceptance criteria are concrete and T010-T013 plan tests, but REQ-006, REQ-007 and REQ-008 have no verifying task.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1, no invented subsystems, no unfilled tokens. Some generic template filler remains (Definition of Done with 'Tests passing (if applicable)', Completion Criteria with 'Manual verification passed').
notes.consistency: Exit codes, file paths and decisions agree across the three docs; spec section 7 correctly points at plan section 3 decisions. Requirements REQ-006/007/008 are not carried into any verification task, and tasks use a shortened test path versus the full path in spec.md.
notes.clarity: A developer could implement this with little ambiguity. Minor gap: plan.md says the gate reads the per-file percentage 'the report used', but that variable is local inside output_text/output_json and is not in scope at the exit point; the missing-value guard under set -u is implied rather than spelled out.

defects: tasks.md:34-61: no task ends with a Verify: clause naming a command and the output that proves it
tasks.md:57-61: no task verifies REQ-006 (flag order composition with --json/--verbose/--quality), REQ-007 (--file mode gate) or REQ-008 (--help text and header comment)
spec.md:80: REQ-003 acceptance cites an unrounded 79.6%, but calculate-completeness.sh line 292 uses bc scale=2 so the ratio is truncated and the product is already an integer; the case is untestable
spec.md:112: claims stderr stays empty on a below-floor result, but the script writes quality warnings (line 410) and file NOT FOUND (lines 323, 332) to stderr
spec.md:59 and plan.md:74: asserts exit 2 is reserved for validation errors in the spec-script taxonomy without grounding in the target script
plan.md:69: says the gate reads the same percentage variable the report used, but in --file mode that variable is declared local inside output_text/output_json and is out of scope at the exit point
plan.md:44-47 and tasks.md:69-71: generic template filler ('Tests passing (if applicable)', 'Manual verification passed') not tailored to this change
plan.md:61-65: names script sections but no line numbers for the parser case (line 544-562), globals (48-52) or exit point (587)
